title: Entrepreneur
description: The applicant as a person, separate from any sign-in account: imported and facilitator-assisted applicants may never sign in. Personal fields are encrypted; contactHash is a keyed hash for duplicate matching (D-14). Nothing here is sent to models or map services (D-13).

userId.description: Linked entrepreneur sign-in account, once the person signs in with their phone.

socialCategoryEnc.description: Optional; scheme eligibility and aggregate monitoring only (Q-23).

contactHashes.description: HMAC-SHA256 of each normalised phone/email, hex. Lets duplicate matching work without decrypting.

placeholderContact.description: True when the contact is a known dummy (for example 9000000080 or @demo.com), so it is excluded from duplicate matching.
